notes.title: Major technical update of the demo version
notes.content:
Full list of changes:

Completely reworked input system

Full gamepad support - now it's comfortable to play on a controller, including full interface control!

Interface update - tips have been reworked, new elements have been added, the control settings window has been improved. Now you can customize the gamepad for yourself.

7 new text localizations: Japanese, Chinese (simplified), German, French, Spanish, Ukrainian, Kazakh.

Bug fixes - minor issues with collisions, display of objects and gameplay elements have been fixed.

Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Technical update #2
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the demo version of ASPIS:

Content:

One of the previously inaccessible institute rooms has been unlocked.

Sound:

Some sound effects have been updated.

Added sound for the PEP-01 device.

Gameplay and interface:

The PEP-01 now captures X-spheres by pressing the button, without having to hold it down.

Reworked the logic of the circular menu for selecting equipment.

Visibility in dark areas has been improved, the brightness of the flashlight has been increased.

Added a mouse inversion setting for the X and Y axes.

The maximum FOV has been increased to 120°.

Pause now actually pauses the game instead of just bringing up the UI.

When receiving a new task, its text is now displayed on the screen, and not just the indicator.

Screen resolution support:

Added 3440x1440 and 3840x1080 resolutions.

Other:

Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Technical update of the demo version
notes.content:
[olist]
New loading system: now you can choose the episode to start the game from.
Additional settings: the menu now includes options for mouse inversion, changing the viewing angle, and adjusting the camera shake.
Ultrawide screen support: 5160x2160 resolution has been added.
Other minor fixes
[/olist]

Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Fire Fix & Subtitles Update
notes.content:
The update fixes a number of issues that interfere with the demo version:

-Fixed playback of Russian subtitles instead of English in a phone conversation in the first location

-Fixed a common bug with extinguishing a fire in a warehouse

-Fixed an error loading the game after the scene with a fire

Thank you for your feedback! It helps to make the game better step by step. If you notice any more problems - write in the discussions.
